scope: reference XW inference for one separately pinned HCSN PFT candidate and supplied expanded features only
inputs: independently retained raw SHA-256 for the complete normal-equation expectations envelope and the complete feature-input JSON; a separately retained request_id; existing candidate tuple and complete statistics bundle verified again by #1017
feature_semantics: each supplied row is the already expanded, normalized feature vector of exactly contract.dimension entries, including any bias; this consumer performs no feature extraction, normalization, bias insertion, transpose, quantization or label access
semantic_binding: feature contract, feature-program, normalization and time-semantic digests must exactly match the separately pinned candidate contract; source_sha256 and row_ids are declarations, not provenance proof
row_identity: one unique lowercase SHA-256 row_id per supplied row; duplicate declared IDs refuse
arithmetic: for each row i and output j, form binary64 products features[i][k]*weight[k][j] for k=0..dimension-1, then math.fsum in that ascending k order
numeric_range: inputs, products and output sums finite and zero or normal binary64; nonzero-factor product rounded to zero refuses; overflow, NaN, infinity, bool and subnormal values refuse
output_encoding: IEEE-754 binary64 little-endian C row-major; output SHA-256 preserves observed signed-zero bytes
reproducibility_scope: the declared Python binary64/fsum reference profile on the observed runtime; no cross-platform consensus determinism or full transitive runtime closure is certified
numerical_acceptance: must first pass the unchanged normal-equation profile; output is an actual reference computation, not a quality metric; no result-dependent tolerance or benchmark threshold
receipt_policy: exclusive new receipt path; retain input refusals, numeric refusals and successful outputs; interrupted writes may be partial; no crash-durability claim
historical_observation_plan: one n8-s17011 candidate already pinned by #1016 and #1017; first four rows of existing train shard0.npz whose prior SHA-256 is e1370cae11b8ad905fed061a348ecf9898bd3da8640f5cbc512c126b4e69c81f; read x only, no retraining or final-test access
public_material: small authored synthetic feature/weight fixtures and digest/shape-only historical summary; private features, weights and full historical outputs stay private
request_id: type must be exactly string containing 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; expected request_id retained separately and must match feature input
json_policy: reject duplicate JSON object keys and nonfinite JSON constants; require exactly the listed expectation and feature fields, with no omissions or additions; normal-equation expectation fields and candidate schemas retain their existing strict validators
expectation_provenance: the reader never constructs its expected pins from submitted candidate, statistics or features; caller-supplied independently retained expectations are required
historical_row_ids: sha256 of ASCII '<previously pinned shard SHA-256>:x:<zero-based local shard row index>' for local indices 0..3
